name: The Upper Midwest & Great Lakes
seasonNote: The biggest region on the trip, best from summer into fall — the northern lakes (Voyageurs, the Boundary Waters, Mackinac, Door County) are summer country, and fall brings color and Grand Rapids' ArtPrize. A few seasonal notes: Holland's Tulip Time is May, and Green Bay and Chicago come alive on game days.
summary: The heart of the country, looping the Great Lakes: Missouri from Kansas City to St. Louis and Mark Twain's Hannibal; Iowa's Des Moines and Field of Dreams; Minnesota's Twin Cities, North Shore, and Boundary Waters; Wisconsin from Door County to Milwaukee; mighty Chicago and Lincoln's Illinois; Indianapolis and the Indiana Dunes; Michigan's Grand Rapids, Mackinac, and Motor City Detroit; and Ohio through Cleveland, Columbus, Dayton, and Cincinnati.
